title: Modem Status
text: Return state of modem control lines, 3 outputs, {Serial port} sets Port that is being accessed Legacy Serial Port; {CTS} sets the enables clear to send status output, {DSR} sets the enables data set ready status output, {DCD} sets the enables data carrier detect status output and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CTS
ports.summary: Status of clear to send line true | false

ports.name: DSR
ports.summary: Status of data set ready line true | false

ports.name: DCD
ports.summary: Status of data carrier detect line true | false

params.name: CTS
params.values: Enables clear to send status output on (default) | off

params.name: DSR
params.values: Enables data set ready status output on (default) | off

params.name: DCD
params.values: Enables data carrier detect status output on (default) | off

params.name: Serial port
params.values: Port that is being accessed Legacy Serial Port 1 (default) |.. | Legacy Serial Port 8 | USB Serial Port 1 |.. | USB Serial Port 8
